content.text:
I removed the Friday rule from `src/solution.py`, so Friday meetings can now start at any otherwise valid time up to the normal latest start (17:00 minus the duration). I didn't run any checks or tests after the edit.

- **Code:** I deleted the block that capped the latest start at 15:00 on Fridays.
- **Docstring:** I removed the mention of the Friday limit.
- **Unchanged:** The function name and signature are the same. The `day` parameter is still accepted, though nothing now uses it. The working hours, lunch break, event conflict handling and 15-minute increments are as before.

I also left the date-to-weekday conversion in place, even though it only fed the Friday check and is now unused.
